title: Psychological characteristics of dissociative and functional disorders
summary: To investigate the psychological characteristics of dissociative and functional disorders and to detect specific patterns, a comprehensive diagnostic assessment using questionnaires and structured interviews will be conducted. For this purpose, relevant data will be collected via self-report and external assessment, stored, and statistically analyzed. Data collection will be carried out both analogously using pen and paper and digitally via a smartphone app. The aim of the study is the specific characterization of patients with dissociative and functional disorders (in contrast to somatic illnesses and healthy control subjects).
conditions: Affective disorders (ICD-10 F30-F39), neurotic, stress-related and somatoform disorders (ICD-10 F40-F48), personality and behavioral disorders (ICD-10 F60-F69), behavioral and emotional disorders with onset in childhood and adolescence (ICD-10 F90-F98).

interventions.name: To research the psychological characteristics of dissociative or functional disorders and to detect specific patterns, extensive diagnostics using questionnaires and structured interviews should be carried out. For this purpose, relevant data should be collected, stored and statistically evaluated v

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Arm 1: (Patients with dissociative and functional disorders): Adult patients up to and including 65 years of age with diagnoses in the areas of affective disorders (ICD-10 F30-F39), neurotic, stress-related, and somatoform disorders (ICD-10 F40-F48), behavioral disorders with somatic symptoms and factors (F50-F59), personality and behavioral disorders (ICD-10 F60-F69), and/or behavioral and emotional disorders with onset in childhood and adolescence (ICD-10 F90-F98).

Arm 2 (Patients with neurological disorders): Adult patients up to and including 65 years of age with diagnoses from the areas of inflammatory diseases of the central nervous system (ICD-10 G00-G09), extrapyramidal diseases and movement disorders (ICD-10 G20-G26), episodic and paroxysmal diseases of the central nervous system (ICD-10 G40-G47) and/or with symptoms affecting the nervous system and the musculoskeletal system (ICD-10 R25-R29).

Arm 3 (Patients with syncopal seizures): Adult patients up to and including 65 years of age with diagnoses of syncope and collapse (ICD-10 R55) and/or other unspecified seizures (ICD-10 R56.8).
Exclusion criteria:
All study arms:
Younger than 18 or older than 65 years, lack of capacity to consent, acute suicidality,
previous brain surgery. Certain infectious and parasitic diseases (ICD-10 A00-B99), malignant tumor diseases (ICD-10 C00-C97), organic mental disorders (ICD-10 F00-F09), serious mental and behavioral disorders due to psychotropic substances (from ICD-10 F10-F19), schizophrenia, schizotypal and delusional disorders (ICD-10 F20-F29), intellectual disabilities (ICD-10 F70-F79), developmental disorders (ICD-10 F80-F89), systemic atrophies predominantly affecting the central nervous system (ICD-10 G10-G14), other degenerative diseases of the nervous system (ICD-10 G30-G32), cerebrovascular diseases (ICD-10 I60-I69), pregnancy, childbirth and the postpartum period (ICD-10 O00-O99).
